name: NVIDIA
design_analysis_text: 現行首頁以 NVIDIA NALA 字體、45px 白色導覽、淺灰 RTX Spark 筆電主視覺與綠色 CTA 展開；目前第一張為 A New Beginning for Windows PCs。六張輪播下方接 GTC Washington, D.C. Nov.30–Dec.3 報名帶、八組產業介紹與水平內容卡，再接黑色品牌頁尾及白色法律頁尾。窄版將介紹、圖片和卡片排成縱向，仍露出下一張水平卡。相較舊稿，首屏、AI 文章與 Automotive 文案已改變，因此本次真正呼叫 Google Stitch MCP，另保存原始 DESKTOP/MOBILE 輸出，並用完整官方 DOM、樣式與 200 個原始素材校正。
visual_review_text: Owner inspected all seven final comparison montage rasters (11 desktop /13 narrow viewport segments per side) and the actual official/local mobile root menu. Exact native raster dimensions1280×720 and390×844; continuous CSS coverage reaches desktop7233px and narrow10350px in both sides. Current first hero image/copy, GTC band, eight industry rows, current article images/copy, footer and root menu were compared. The narrow official first-frame image has a darker transitional fade than the static local frame. Native provider screen thumbnails were inspected and remain unaccepted; generated ordering/theme differ from the current official first slide.
implementation_method: Source-backed correction after genuine native Google Stitch edit. Complete current per-width public DOM/CSS, observed currentSrc originals and source SVG symbol styles retained; original network/application scripts omitted. Local hero frozen to observed current slide1.
corrections: Replaced old hero/current AI article content and Automotive description using observed current official text/assets; restored all eight complete industry rows and footer.

Forced current first slide rather than whichever autoplay slide was active at the end of source capture; corrected @2x intrinsic image density to observed1350×770 desktop and390×550 narrow display sizes.
Restored source light-theme black progress text and source SVG symbol-scoped styles so menu/search/close glyphs render correctly.
Recreated observed narrow root menu markup and tested opening and Escape closing with current preview.
remaining_differences_and_limits: Official six-slide hero autoplays every7s. Local first slide, progress fill and content-row positions are frozen; remaining slide selection, autoplay, transitions and horizontal navigation are not fully implemented/verified.
The captured narrow official first hero is a darker transition frame; local static image is brighter. Exact transition opacity/time and native scrollbar/focus-ring appearance are not matched.
Only narrow root menu opening and Escape closing were tested. Nested menus, desktop menus, country selector, search, sign-in, quick links and other interactions remain unverified.
Official US page showed a Taiwan geolocation recommendation; initial banner was recorded then dismissed. Main evidence retains exact en-us URL without claiming Taiwan/other regional equivalence.

Native provider output does not reproduce the current first-slide theme/order precisely and stays unaccepted. No account, purchase, subscription, live service, other widths, physical phone or hosted-publication parity is claimed.
progress_note: Current-hash complete desktop/narrow raster inspection completed with7233/10350px coverage, current first hero/articles/originals/menu corrected. Motion, transition, root-menu and service limits explicit; accepted=false.
